name: Smart Lamp Maxi
author: buildwithnoknok
description: The fully stacked Smart Lamp: a lamp, a bedside clock, a kitchen timer and a wake-up light in one. The display shows the time, the knob sets brightness and colour, the button switches the light on and off or starts a gentle sundown fade. Set an alarm and the lamp slowly brightens like a sunrise before it rings.
assembly_guide: Connect the USB LEDs 16x module to the PicoHub's USB port.
Connect the LED Button, the Knob, the Buzzer and the Display to the PicoHub I2C ports.
Run setup in the noknok app, then pick your time zone on the lamp's settings page.

controls.action: Sundown: the lamp fades gently to off over the sundown time
Shows the lamp colour while the lamp is on
Brightness — or colour after a tap. The framed bar on the display shows which
Switch the knob between brightness and colour (back to brightness after 5 s)
Menu: Timer, Alarm, Sundown, Reset lamp. Turn to choose, tap to confirm, hold to leave
Button press = stop the timer / snooze the alarm 5 min. Hold the button = stop the alarm
Factory reset — keep holding until the LED flashes, goes dark and the buzzer sounds (about 8 s)
